name: deploy-manager
description: A small, rollback-aware release control plane for Dockerized apps on one Linux VPS.

scripts.test: node --test tests/city3d.test.mjs tests/deploy-app.test.mjs tests/docker-network.test.mjs tests/probes.test.mjs tests/public-homepage.test.mjs tests/release-journal.test.mjs tests/self-update.test.mjs tests/setup.test.mjs
scripts.test:release: node --test tests/deploy-app.test.mjs tests/docker-network.test.mjs tests/probes.test.mjs tests/public-homepage.test.mjs tests/release-journal.test.mjs tests/self-update.test.mjs tests/setup.test.mjs
scripts.check: node --check src/server.mjs && node --check src/release-journal.mjs && node --check client/city3d.js && node --check client/plot-layout.js && node --check public/app.js && node --check scripts/dev.mjs && node --check scripts/setup.mjs && npm run test:release
scripts.check:ci: npm run build:city && npm run check && node --test tests/city3d.test.mjs && git diff --exit-code -- public/city3d.bundle.js
